# Documentation and Runbook Discipline

## Core Principles

- Keep quick start and setup in top-level README files.
- Keep deep technical details in focused docs under `docs/`.
- Update docs in the same change where behavior changes.

## Writing Rules

- Prefer concise, operationally useful instructions.
- Include concrete validation and troubleshooting steps.
- Keep examples aligned with the current implementation.
